One [published grading record](https://index.broadcastwell.com/data/php2shell/study/study-grades.csv) for a Claude answer about WordPress on 23 October 2026 is labeled Incomplete and potentially misleading while its invented-facts field is empty. The answer uses the words “As a temporary measure”; the recorded review nevertheless says the Cloudflare protection was presented as a fix rather than a stopgap. An empty field does not certify that every sentence was true; it shows why the explicit label and reason must be read together rather than deriving a no-false-claim subset from the aggregate totals. This historical review is not current mitigation guidance.
